The card clearly showed it was a PDF, and "Open saved PDF" brought up the actual document in its own viewer with the real filename and a Download button, so I can pull the real file back out whenever I want. That's the reassurance I needed for those — the app is holding the genuine document, not just a tidied-up retelling of it, so even if the source link dies I've still got the paper itself. This settles the PDF case nicely, and I'm happy with how preserving works overall now.
